from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Extend every contiguous diagonal pair of a non-background color along its diagonal.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == grid[0][0]:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == color:
                    for sr, sc in ((-dr, -dc), (dr, dc)):
                        rr, cc = (r, c) if (sr, sc) == (-dr, -dc) else (nr, nc)
                        rr += sr
                        cc += sc
                        while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == grid[0][0]:
                            out[rr][cc] = color
                            rr += sr
                            cc += sc
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-3d8e0950.py'
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(path),'exec'),globals())
# Build demo inputs and expected outputs compactly from background and changed coordinates.
def grid(h,w,bg,changes):
    a=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c,v in changes: a[r][c]=v
    return a
# Demo 1 expected fills are the 5 and 7 diagonal rays reported.
d1=grid(9,23,1,[(4,13,5),(5,14,5),(5,15,3),(6,14,7),(6,15,0),(7,13,7)])
e1=grid(9,23,1,[(r,9+r,5) for r in range(5)]+[(4,13,5),(5,14,5),(5,15,3),(6,14,7),(6,15,0),(7,13,7),(8,12,7)])
# Demo 2
D2=grid(11,23,9,[(4,2,0),(5,0,0),(5,1,0),(6,0,4),(6,1,5),(7,2,5)])
E2=grid(11,23,9,[(r,6-r,0) for r in range(5)]+[(5,0,0),(5,1,0),(4,2,0),(6,0,4),(6,1,5)]+[(r,r-5,5) for r in range(6,11)]+[(7,2,5)])
D3=grid(11,8,7,[(5,2,4),(5,3,0),(6,2,9),(6,3,0)])
print('d1',transform(d1)==e1,'d2',transform(D2)==E2,'d3',transform(D3)==D3)
test=[[2,2,2,2,2,7]+[2]*18,[2,2,2,6,7]+[2]*19,[2,2,2,1,7]+[2]*19]+[[2]*24 for _ in range(4)]
ans=transform(test)
print(ans)
print('saved',path)
